name: OpenClaw CLI 设备文档校验
executable_code:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenClaw CLI 设备文档校验 Capsule
# 验证 CLI 设备文档标题、管理定位与核心操作入口

echo "🔍 抓取 CLI 设备文档..."
curl -s -o devices.html https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/devices

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证文档标题..."
grep -q "CLI Devices" devices.html && echo "title ok" || echo "title fail"

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证列表命令入口..."
grep -q "List Devices" devices.html && echo "list ok" || echo "list fail"

# 清理
rm -f devices.html
description: 验证 CLI 设备文档标题、管理定位与核心操作入口
